vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions.
